title: Public Debate Engine
scope: All work merged and unmerged shares one roadmap denominator.

milestones.title: Plan and cross-account handoff
milestones.acceptanceNote: Full source plan exists; Engine Room onboarding not independently verified.

milestones.title: Neutral web foundation and CI
milestones.acceptanceNote: Source foundation, public shell, test/build CI merged.

milestones.title: Database schema, migration and integrity
milestones.acceptanceNote: PostgreSQL schema + real migration/immutability CI; Neon development branch migrated.

milestones.title: Authentication and campaign permissions
milestones.acceptanceNote: Neon Auth and candidate registration work. Delegates and strengthened administrator MFA still missing.

milestones.title: Election and candidacy verification
milestones.acceptanceNote: Verified candidate workflow, decision reasons and independent appeals in source. Real human verification policy missing.

milestones.title: Versioned reciprocal debate rules
milestones.acceptanceNote: Core reciprocal rules exist, but explicit immutable rule-version negotiations and terminal-turn protocol are incomplete.

milestones.title: Secure persistent video uploads
milestones.acceptanceNote: Originals stored with SHA-256 and server validation, but upload limited to 60MiB and not resumable.

milestones.title: Media processing and captions
milestones.acceptanceNote: FFmpeg source worker and captions implemented; isolated production worker not hosted and virus scanning incomplete.

milestones.title: Supporting document versioning
milestones.acceptanceNote: Append-only PDFs/TXT/DOCX; comprehensive malware scanning and corrections still incomplete.

milestones.title: Debate initiation and publication
milestones.acceptanceNote: Candidate opening composer and transactional publish implemented; multi-user authenticated pilot pending.

milestones.title: Candidate response branches
milestones.acceptanceNote: Contender response composer/public ledger implemented; safe nonqualifying archive enhancement in PR32.

milestones.title: Question assessment and objections
milestones.acceptanceNote: Attributed assessments and respondent objections implemented; video corrections not completed.

milestones.title: Qualified reciprocal sequences
milestones.acceptanceNote: Qualifying public sequence projection works; materialized historical manifests still missing.

milestones.title: Reply deadlines and notifications
milestones.acceptanceNote: Database-backed obligations and deadline worker source implemented; no external notification adapter deployed.

milestones.title: Full public debate pages
milestones.acceptanceNote: Large original video, all responses, questions and footnotes shown; full usability acceptance pending.

milestones.title: Accessible player and transcript search
milestones.acceptanceNote: Public WebVTT and transcript search; independent caption review, manual accessibility testing pending.

milestones.title: Public discovery and candidate pages
milestones.acceptanceNote: Verified candidate directory and profiles; office/topic filtering and performance work remain.

milestones.title: Candidate workspace
milestones.acceptanceNote: Candidate workspace, obligations and media review available; delegates and draft/resume flow incomplete.

milestones.title: Versioned synthesized policy agreements
milestones.acceptanceNote: Hash-bound, versioned, joint policy acceptance implemented; scoped partial agreements and withdrawals pending.

milestones.title: Media editing and usage permission
milestones.acceptanceNote: Original-owner clip permission and exact rendered-file approvals implemented; revocation and full consent acceptance pending.

milestones.title: Summary video production
milestones.acceptanceNote: FFmpeg worker source, test footage, review UI, lease safety. Worker hosting/media pilot remain unverified.

milestones.title: Agreement press packages
milestones.acceptanceNote: Downloadable press evidence ZIP, public press room and RSS implemented; operational acceptance pending.

milestones.title: Authorized dissemination
milestones.acceptanceNote: Passive RSS only; no externally authorized email/social provider or delivery evidence.

milestones.title: Open API and campaign integration
milestones.acceptanceNote: Versioned OpenAPI read-only SDK and embeds; separate downstream campaign integration pending.

milestones.title: Security and E2EESA applicability review
milestones.acceptanceNote: Negative SQL authorization tests and source integrity rules; external E2EESA/security audit missing.

milestones.title: Preservation restrictions and restore
milestones.acceptanceNote: Read-only checksum audit and immutable SQL constraints; offsite backup/recovery and safety restriction process missing.

milestones.title: Full adversarial browser acceptance
milestones.acceptanceNote: Real PostgreSQL CI, FFmpeg CI and Render smoke; genuine two-user browser acceptance pending.

milestones.title: Accessibility and performance acceptance
milestones.acceptanceNote: Visual/mobile and WCAG/media manual acceptance not performed.

milestones.title: Approved Render and Neon production deployment
milestones.acceptanceNote: Only Render preview and Neon development resources wired. Production deployment not approved or completed.

milestones.title: Production release and handoff
milestones.acceptanceNote: Do not mark complete until production acceptances and operational evidence are present.

implementationNote: PR references show source work, not security/operational acceptance. The milestone count is not equal to individual PR counts.
